title: Priority-scaled regression guard hook for prompt sets
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Introduces a new CI guard hook that scales regression signals by prompt-set priority to reduce noisy failures. Improves signal-to-noise for critical prompt lists and includes observability and a small migration guide.
description: Motivation: our current prompt-regression CI gate treats all prompt-sets equally which leads to noisy interrupts for low-priority cohorts and buries actionable alerts for high-priority prompts. This PR adds a priority-scaled regression guard hook that weights per-prompt regressions by a customer-defined priority score and aggregates a severity-adjusted signal used to pass/fail CI. Design summary: 1) new hook implementation (ci/hooks/priority_scaled_guard.py) that consumes per-prompt regression metrics and a priority weightmap; 2) configuration file (metrics/priority_weights.yaml) and per-repo opt-in in ci/config.yml; 3) new unit + integration tests and a demo prompt set. Checklist: [x] implement hook logic and thresholds [x] add unit tests and integration test harness [x] add lightweight docs and example prompt-set [x] add CI gating wiring and alerting hooks [x] update metric labels and dashboards. Commits: Initial prototype of weight-scaled aggregator and API, Add unit tests for weight buckets and thresholding, Wire hook into CI runner and add example config, Fix flaky integration test and add telemetry tags. Files changed (high level): ci/hooks/priority_scaled_guard.py (core logic), eval-harness/tests/test_priority_guard.py (unit/integration), eval-harness/docs/regression-hooks.md (design + migration notes), eval-harness/ci/config.yml (opt-in flag), eval-harness/metrics/priority_weights.yaml (example weightmap), eval-harness/examples/priority-demo/prompt_set.json (demo), setup.py (test deps). CI notes: initial CI run flagged a timing-sensitive integration test (regressionsuite) which caused a temporary fail; test timeout was tuned, then full suite passed; nightly metrics-check job updated to surface severity-weighted alerts. Review conversation summary: Reviewer Maria Chen requested clearer naming for 'priority score' vs 'severity weight' and suggested adding a small doc section about operational behavior; author updated docs and renamed internal fields to 'priority_weight' to avoid confusion; Ethan Gomez asked for an explicit fallback path when a prompt-set has no configured weight, we default to weight=0.2 and documented it; Priya Singh requested telemetry tags for per-priority buckets and a short runbook entry, both were added. Merge outcome: merged via squash on 2026-02-10 after approvals and green CI. Related work: links to ENG-4572 (reduce noisy prompt-gate failures) and ENG-4620 (improve critical prompt monitoring). Impact: reduces false-positive CI failures for low-priority prompt sets while improving detection for prioritized prompts. No user-facing API changes beyond opt-in CI config.
